europe_now.title: Crimean Bridge Attack and Conflict Escalation
europe_now.summary: Key infrastructure in Ukraine has faced major strikes, including a significant partial collapse of the Crimean Bridge following an attack by Ukraine. Russian officials have also criticized foreign military presence, describing French troop involvement as direct participation in the ongoing conflict.

europe_now.title: Nationwide Public Sector Strikes and Political Debates in France
europe_now.summary: France is experiencing widespread public sector strikes and cost-of-living protests that have brought tens of thousands of demonstrators onto the streets. Meanwhile, political figures continue to debate economic policies and retirement reforms ahead of the upcoming presidential race.

top_stories.title: French Labor Protests and Political Campaigning
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of workers across France have joined nationwide protests and public-sector strikes demanding better salaries and opposing current economic pressures. Political contenders are actively campaigning and defending proposed retirement reforms amidst the demonstrations.
